localChanges: Once a game starts, a history entry of our own catches Back and asks whether to leave; anything else that would leave the page gets the browser's own prompt. The page's own reloads (the reload shortcut, loading a save, importing assets) have already asked, so they skip it.

Teardown moves from `beforeunload` to `pagehide`, and skips a page kept for the back/forward cache: a cancelled leave, or a page restored after one, used to come back with nothing listening to the worker.
